hot.title: Blade yard, Goleniów

conflicts.what: overhead power line 110 kV over the route

measures: Use the oncoming lane for about 2070 m (wheels up to 4.6 m across the centre line): the escort holds oncoming traffic; keeping right the wheels would leave the road by up to 1.7 m.
Overswing zone of about 2190 m² beyond the road edge (the blade reaches up to 21 m out), kept clear of everything above the blade underside.
Open or take down about 38 m of fence in the swept path.
Dismount 3 street lamps in the swept area.
Unbolt 1 give-way sign in the swept area.
The wheel units run within 0.2 m of the carriageway edge on a road without hard shoulder (kerb and footway): the remote-steered rear dolly needs a spotter on foot.
A 113° turn within 40 m: walking pace, the junction closed for the passage.
hot.why: 113° turn; blade up to 21 m beyond the road; fence, fire hydrant in the swept area — the plant's own exit, used for every blade it ships

evidence.t: The local paper reports that the Hoßkirch blades travelled by road from Stettin (Szczecin) in a convoy of three, several days on the road.
Vestas says the Goleniów plant near Szczecin will continue to deliver blades for the V172-7.2 MW.

hot.note: The press names Stettin; the plant at Goleniów (25 km away) is inferred: it is the only V172 blade plant near Szczecin. Inside the plant the blades move on its own roads; the survey starts where the convoy leaves the yard on Prosta.
hot.road: Prosta → Granitowa → S3/S6 junction Goleniów Południe (exit 15)

conflicts.what: trees in the blade swing (30 surveyed crowns)

measures: Use the oncoming lane for about 330 m (wheels up to 6.3 m across the centre line): the escort holds oncoming traffic; keeping right the wheels would leave the road by up to 1.1 m.
Dismantle the guardrail on the inside of the loop for the passage (reported for this ramp; guardrails are missing from the open map data).

evidence.t: A blade got stuck on the ramp from the B 30 onto the B 32 at Niederbiegen near Weingarten at 2:30 a.m.; the guardrail on the inside of the curve was in the way. The second blade waited on the hard shoulder. The ramp stayed closed for the day while guardrails were taken down; the convoy continued after dark.

evidence.t: Near Hirschegg, between Hangen and Altshausen, the remote-controlled rear steering axle of a blade transporter (blade about 85 m, about 35 t) ran off the road to the left. An excavator stabilised it and brought it back onto the road; the B 32 was closed until about 10:30, damage several tens of thousands of euros. The convoy of three then continued to Hoßkirch.
evidence.s: Police report and Schwäbische Zeitung, 11 Jun 2025

factory.name: LM Wind Power blade plant (Vestas since September 2025)
facts: Built the V172 blades for Vestas under contract; Vestas signed the takeover on 15 May 2025 and runs the plant since 5 September 2025, saying it will continue to deliver V172-7.2 MW blades.
Blade storage beside the S3 expressway shows in the 2021 Sentinel-2 composite; the map data calls the yard ‘Vestas Blades’.
